description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Re-hydrates retrieved vector search results or chunks by restoring token placeholders with authentic data from the volatile RAM session before presenting to the user.

results.description: Array of retrieved search result objects ({ id?: string, text?: string, pageContent?: string, score?: number, metadata?: object }) or strings containing tokens to restore.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for isolated multi-task agent memory. Defaults to 'default'.

name: guard_rag_restore
